decision.reasoning_trace: The search was focused on high-quality portable speakers with strong ratings and water resistance for versatile use. The consideration set included popular budget options like MusiBaby (prod_151) and NOTABRICK (prod_168), as well as a rugged Altec Lansing (prod_040). The JBL Charge 4 (prod_013), although renewed, was selected as the final choice because it offers the best combination of sound performance, build quality, and brand reputation at a highly competitive price point compared to buying new or opting for lower-tier brands.
